title: Nanomaterials and Microscopy: Pushing Scientific Frontiers in Brazil
content: The Brazilian Society of Microscopy and Microanalysis (SBMM) (www.sbmm.org.br), the oldest microscopy society in Latin America, was founded in 1971 as a non-profit organization dedicated to promoting and advancing microscopy and microanalysis techniques and applications across all scientific fields. Since its inception, SBMM has played a central role in the dissemination and development of microscopy in Brazil and South America.
